name: How long does skylight repair typically take?
description: Skylight repair can take a few hours for minor issues or a full day or more for complex problems, depending on damage and weather.

mainEntity.name: How long does skylight repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of skylight repair varies depending on the extent of the damage and the type of repair needed. Minor repairs, such as resealing flashing or replacing a small pane, might take a few hours. More complex issues, like replacing the entire unit or repairing significant structural damage around the skylight, could take a full day or more. Weather conditions, especially rain or strong winds, can also impact the repair timeline, potentially delaying work to ensure proper sealing and safety.
